decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a core component technology that builds directly on the firm's combustion know-how and feeds into its whole heater range, so it is easy to improve and hard to give up.
The plaque heater has its own page and is close to the firm's established infrared expertise, so the firm can read its market results well and refine it.
The luminous radiant heater rests on the same gas infrared knowledge base, so keeping it fits the firm's capacity to absorb learning, though it was only mentioned on the website.
The tube heater is closely related to existing competence, but it overlaps with Product F, so one variant may be consolidated.
The standard plaque heater is a staple of the core line with its own page, and it draws directly on accumulated know-how.
It sits squarely in the firm's competence, but as a second tube heater variant it is the more likely of the two to be merged or phased out.
